description: This header file declares internal API functions for the Slap Bmc2 Output Object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It includes prototypes for reset, clear, write, erase line, and move cursor functions used internally in the implementation.

methods.name: SlapBmc2OutoReset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the Slap Bmc2 Output Object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2OutoClear
methods.description: Clears the output display or buffer.

methods.name: SlapBmc2OutoEraseLine
methods.description: Erases the current line in the output.

methods.name: SlapBmc2OutoMoveCursor
methods.description: Moves the cursor in specified direction (UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT/HOME/END).
